view: Frontal chest radiograph, probably AP (scapulae project over the lateral lung fields, cardiac/mediastinal silhouette magnified); L marker at image upper right confirms conventional orientation (patient's left on image right)
technical_quality: Suboptimal but diagnostic. Moderate/slightly shallow inspiration; mandible and lower cervical spine superimposed on the upper mediastinum/apices (chin not raised); no significant rotation (medial clavicle ends roughly equidistant from the spinous processes); both scapulae overlap the lateral lung fields; large breast shadows and generous soft tissue overlie both lower zones; penetration adequate (thoracic spine faintly visible behind heart); costophrenic angles included; black rectangular collimation/edge artifact at the left image border.

devices.type: External radiographic side marker 'L' with radiopaque clip-type holder (external artifact, not a medical device)
devices.location: Image upper right, projected over the patient's left shoulder / acromioclavicular region

devices.type: Small round radiopaque object, likely jewellery (earring/pendant/piercing) - external artifact
devices.location: Top edge of the image, midline, just above the mandible

abnormalities.finding: Mild prominence of the hila and perihilar bronchovascular markings without a definite focal consolidation, mass, nodule or air-bronchogram; right hilum slightly more bulky than left
Borderline enlarged cardiac silhouette (CTR approximately 0.50-0.52), most likely magnification on AP projection with modest inspiration rather than true cardiomegaly; normal cardiac contour
Broad-appearing superior mediastinum, probably technical (AP projection, shallow inspiration, superimposed mandible/cervical spine) in a young woman; trachea midline, no discrete mass

description_zh: 胸部正面X光（疑為AP投影，吸氣稍淺，下頷骨與頸椎重疊於上縱膈，雙側肩胛骨重疊於外側肺野，雙側乳房陰影覆蓋下肺野）。雙側肺門及肺門周圍支氣管血管紋理輕度增加，右側肺門略顯飽滿，但未見明確局部實質化、腫塊、結節或肋膜積液，雙側肋膈角銳利，未見氣胸。心影邊界大小（CTR約0.5）及上縱膈顯得較寬，推測多為AP投影放大及吸氣不足所致，氣管居中；骨骼結構未見明顯骨折或破壞。無任何體內導管、引流管或節律器，僅見左側標記「L」及頂端中線一小圓形金屬異物（疑為飾品）。
